description: Hamza Agent Hub boss with FULL roster awareness: differentiates work across Desk, ECC68, Forge, and Tools13 and assigns the right specialists.
Connects Hamza Agent Hub to FreeLLMAPI — open-source free OpenAI-compatible LLM gateway (auto-routing across free tiers).
Browse everything in the one plugin: all packs, 90+ agents, tools13, and MCP surface tools. Search by query or open a specific agent_id.

Real web browser automation and web research on CPU-only headless Chromium (Playwright): navigate, snapshot, click, type, extract structured data, screenshot, plus cited web search. Distinct from hub-agent-browse, which browses the Hub catalog.
Triage inbound mail text, score the lead, and draft a reply a human reviews before send.
Take weekly numbers (CSV/text), compare with prior week, and draft a short report.
Normalize meeting notes, extract next actions, and draft the follow-up.
Clean and dedupe lead emails from messy text or CSV using Automation Desk logic.
Detect which code-hosting forge a URL belongs to among 20 supported platforms.
Apply GitHub URL tricks, search operators, and repo intelligence workflows.
Mine public repos for agents, skills, MCP servers and tools using curated queries.
Turn discovered capabilities into a curated skill-pack outline with provenance.
Lapian Notes Companion — Included full original ChatGPT plugin archive; samples film frames, not full film AI analysis. Source: https://github.com/bkingfilm/lapian-notes. Tested: PASS_LOCAL_CODE.
Free Marketing SEO Audit — Included full user-owned original plugin archive; NOT an Okara client. Works on HTML. Source: https://okara.ai/agent. Tested: PASS_LOCAL_CODE.

nanoMuse Bridge — Private ChatGPT plugin available by plugin ID, not archived in this ZIP; official upstream source retrievable. Not Boss-connected. Source: https://github.com/nano-muse/nanoMuse. Tested: PASS_CLI_UNIT_20_AND_MOCK_BRIDGE.

n8n Workflow Library — Private ChatGPT skill not archived; official workflows available by separate source fetch. No flow activated. Source: https://github.com/Zie619/n8n-workflows. Tested: PASS_PUBLIC_WORKFLOW_JSON_VALIDATION.

ECC 68 Skills — 68 actual skill files confirmed in private plugin, but original private release archive not bundled; upstream sources available. Source: https://github.com/affaan-m/ECC. Tested: PASS_68_FILES_AND_REFERENCES.
Munder Difflin — Electron app tests; desktop UI was not run; no Boss connection. Source: https://github.com/HarnessMD/munder-difflin. Tested: PASS_18_OF_18_UNIT_TESTS.
Scrapling — Requires additional packages; sample public fetch was verified. Source: https://github.com/D4Vinci/Scrapling. Tested: PASS_HTML_PARSER_AND_LIVE_HTTP_200.

Goose CLI — goose --version 1.54.0 passed. Doctor requires provider configuration. User must authorize any paid provider. Source: https://github.com/aaif-goose/goose. Tested: PASS_GOOSEx64_CLI_VERSION_ONLY.
Headroom — Local compression example retained FATAL in logs. Source: https://github.com/headroomlabs-ai/headroom. Tested: PASS_LOCAL_COMPRESSION.
GLM-5.3-Flash — Large model weights intentionally excluded; needs appropriate GPU provider. Source: https://huggingface.co/zai-org/GLM-5.3-Flash. Tested: MODEL_METADATA_VERIFIED_NOT_INFERENCED.
Kimi K3 — Large model weights intentionally excluded; needs appropriate GPU provider. Source: https://huggingface.co/moonshotai/Kimi-K3. Tested: MODEL_METADATA_VERIFIED_NOT_INFERENCED.
Open Generative AI — Full AI video generation not run; may require external model/API resources. Source: https://github.com/Anil-matcha/Open-Generative-AI. Tested: PASS_50_OF_50_UNIT_TESTS.
Agent Reach — Selected public and security unit tests; some channels require credentials. Source: https://github.com/Panniantong/Agent-Reach. Tested: PASS_81_OF_81_UNIT_TESTS.
